value: Training-seed sd on tight2 is 0.010 train / 0.013 held-out, pooled within 16 arm-and-round groups over 66-67 runs (47 df); arms sharing a round-0 net pool to ~0.009 / 0.009, fresh round 0s to 0.012 / 0.018. MDE = 2.8 x sd x sqrt(2/seeds), ~0.02-0.03 at 3 unpaired seeds; paired arms that share data can see ~0.01.

sources.anchor: Recipe comparisons are dominated by training-seed variance. At today's seed sd, 3 seeds cannot detect the 0.01 effects most arms were sized for, and the fight-only gate is not a recipe verdict.

note: resolves the docs: '66 runs' (manager.md) and '16 groups' (big-picture-2026-10-31b diagnosis) describe the same pool; the older 0.006-0.0075 came from one shared-draw group (rung-4 seed check) and is wrong as a general sd. Reproduced by two skeptics from runs/*/round.json
